name: The Backlot — ground-truth agent evaluation
description: Scores Control Room against the anomalies deliberately seeded into the ClickHouse dataset. Rubrics are generated from data/generated/ANOMALIES.json, so they always describe the data that is actually loaded. Includes two negative cases — no false-positive royalty findings, and no invented incident — because an agent that always finds something is not a useful one.

parts.text: What happened during the Midnight Marquee premiere in Brazil? Check both playback health and ad revenue, and tell me whether they share a root cause.

rubric_content.text_property: The response identifies the specific failing CDN edge node 'sa-east-1b' in territory BR as the location of the problem.
The response states the specific time window of the degradation (approximately 19:05-19:20 UTC), rather than describing the problem vaguely.
The response reports the playback symptom with concrete numbers: elevated buffering time, rebuffering, or viewer drop-off rate.
The response reports the advertising symptom: SSAI ad-stitching failures, quantified as lost revenue in dollars.

The response explicitly concludes that the playback degradation and the ad-insertion failures are TWO SYMPTOMS OF ONE root cause on the same node in the same window — not two separate unrelated problems listed side by side.
The answer draws on both playback telemetry and advertising data, showing more than one specialist domain was consulted.

parts.text: Audit the royalty payments across the catalog. Show me the arithmetic behind any discrepancy you find.

rubric_content.text_property: The response identifies contract c003 (Kenji Watanabe) as underpaid.
The response explains the root cause of that underpayment as an escalation tier that was triggered but paid at the base rate — the escalation clause was effectively ignored.
The response identifies contract c004 (Marcus Chen) as underpaid against a flat fee.
The response shows its working: the unit count (streams, minutes or attributed revenue), the rate(s) applied, the expected total, the amount actually paid, and the resulting gap in dollars.
The reported gaps are approximately $462.84 for c003 and $7,797.96 for c004 (within about 5%).
The response does NOT claim that contracts other than these two are materially underpaid. Every other contract is correct to within ordinary rounding drift.

parts.text: Is anyone watching this premiere who shouldn't be? Rank anything suspicious and tell me why.

rubric_content.text_property: The response identifies device fingerprint 'fp-ring-77c1' as the top suspicious cluster.
The response quantifies the ring: approximately 90 distinct accounts sharing one device.
The response justifies the flag with at least two corroborating signals — e.g. account fan-out AND impossible travel AND/OR session concurrency — not fan-out alone.
The response does NOT flag ordinary shared-device households or public/venue devices as fraud. Those have high account fan-out but no impossible travel and no concurrency spike, and are legitimate.

parts.text: Is any title losing its audience? If so, when did it turn and why?

rubric_content.text_property: The response identifies 'Static Bloom' (t02) as the title at retention risk.
The response names when the decline began, around 2026-08-29 (roughly day 14 after release).
The response quantifies the decline in average watch time as a percentage or absolute change, rather than asserting it vaguely.
The response cross-checks sentiment data and notes that sentiment turned negative over the same period, strengthening the signal.

parts.text: Was there any CDN or ad-delivery incident affecting Nova Horizon in Japan? Be precise.

rubric_content.text_property: The response states that no significant incident was found for that title/territory, rather than manufacturing one to seem useful.
The response supports that conclusion with actual queried figures (e.g. buffering and fill rates near baseline), not just an assertion.
The response does not invent specific incidents, node names, time windows or dollar losses that it did not obtain from the data.
